text:
{
  "claims": [
    {
      "anchor": "A shared cache stores responses for reuse by more than one user",
      "claim_text": "A shared cache stores responses for reuse by more than one user.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P0.S0."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "a private cache is dedicated to a single user",
      "claim_text": "A private cache is dedicated to a single user.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P0.S1."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Origin servers normally set freshness with the Expires header or the max-age directive",
      "claim_text": "Origin servers normally set freshness with the Expires header or the max-age directive.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P1.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P1.S0 says primary mechanism is explicit expiration via Expires or max-age."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "when neither is present, a cache may assign a heuristic expiration time",
      "claim_text": "When no explicit expiration time is specified, a cache may assign a heuristic expiration time.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P2.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P2.S0 states cache MAY assign heuristic expiration when explicit time not specified."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "it must not use a heuristic when an explicit expiration time is present",
      "claim_text": "A cache must not use heuristics to determine freshness when an explicit expiration time is present.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P3.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P3.S0."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "With Last-Modified, a typical heuristic is 10% of the time since that date",
      "claim_text": "With Last-Modified, a typical heuristic expiration value is 10% of the interval since that time.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S0", "rel": "entails"}, {"sid": "P4.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P4.S0 encourages fraction of interval; P4.S1 gives typical 10%."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "a response last modified 30 days ago could be treated as fresh for about 3 days",
      "claim_text": "A response last modified 30 days ago could be treated as fresh for about 3 days under a 10% heuristic.",
      "kind": "arith",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": {"kind": "arith", "expr": "30 * 0.10", "op": "==", "value": "3"},
      "reasoning": "10% of 30 days is 3 days; P4.S1 gives 10%."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "The Age header is the cache's estimate of the number of seconds since the origin generated or validated the response",
      "claim_text": "The Age header is the cache's estimate of the number of seconds since the origin server generated or validated the response.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P5.S1."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "A max-stale request directive without a value accepts a stale response of any age",
      "claim_text": "A max-stale request directive without a value accepts a stale response of any age.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P7.S2", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P7.S2."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "s-maxage overrides max-age and Expires for a shared cache",
      "claim_text": "For a shared cache, s-maxage overrides max-age and Expires.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P9.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P9.S0 states s-maxage overrides max-age or Expires for shared cache."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "proxy-revalidate is the analogue of must-revalidate",
      "claim_text": "proxy-revalidate is analogous to must-revalidate.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P8.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P8.S1 states this analogy."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "proxy-revalidate does not apply to private caches",
      "claim_text": "proxy-revalidate does not apply to private caches.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P8.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P8.S1 states proxy-revalidate does not apply to private caches."
    }
  ]
}
